items.title: Bob Rosengarden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 6, 1996
items.q: Dick Gibson was, is still alive, out in Denver. An impresario.

ctx.x: So it wasn’t one of the players.

No. Dick Gibson was, is still alive, out in Denver. An impresario. I mean he was a businessman who did very well and he loved Hag and he loved Yank Lawson. Yank was quite a drinker in those days. And so Yank would mumble a lot, and Hag was just Mount Pleasant. And I played in that band at various times. Cliff Leeman was the first drummer. And Cliff did a wonderful job for that band, much better than I did. I imitated him. I did my mimicking. I imitated what he did. But he meant it. And I enjoyed playing with that…
You’ve been a part of so many interesting ensembles, the “New York Repertory.”
